messages:
Clara Nguyen: Quick mock of a compact latency card for dashboard rows 14 p95 prominent, small throughput sparkline under, and a tiny 'Sampling' badge top-right that opens an inline popover. Attached a screenshot. Thoughts on keyboard nav and screen-reader labels? :wave: Devon Park: Nice comp. A few things: 1) p95 should stay the visual anchor, 2) throughput needs an explicit unit label (RPS) or we’ll get confused, 3) sampling badge should show the current mode (Adaptive / Fixed %) so users see state at a glance. :eyes: Ravi Patel: Accessibility checklist: badge must be focusable via keyboard and include aria-expanded + aria-controls. Popover content should use role="menu" or role="dialog" consistently and have visible focus styles. Add sr-only explanation for what "Sampling" does. Lena Ortiz: Copy suggestions: use "Sampling: Adaptive" not "Sampler: auto". Tooltip for the badge: "Controls how many requests are rendered to reduce noise & cost." Change throughput label to "Throughput (RPS)". Jorge Morales: On narrow widths this layout is tight. Consider collapsing throughput into a single icon that expands on click. Mobile should prioritize p95 only and hide the est. cost line. DesignBot: automated-lint: contrast-fail for badge microcopy at current color #8c8c8c, recommended AA accessible color or bold weight. See: https://redwood.design/contrast-checker/2003456799 :robot_face: Samira Lee: Product question: if we show an "est. cost" hint in the popover (eg "est. $0.02 / 1k tokens"), customers might misread that as billing info. Suggest copy: "Estimated rendering cost for sampled traces only; not billed." Also +1 on showing sampling mode on the badge. Clara Nguyen: Updated interaction notes: keyboard shortcut `t` toggles the time picker. When the sampling popover opens, focus should go to the first control. Draft ARIA snippet to hand to frontend: ```
``` Devon Park: Timepicker keyboard behavior: left/right moves the range by the smallest preset delta, Shift+left/Shift+right jumps by day/week. Add this to keyboard shortcuts modal. Also show exact RPS on throughput-sparkline hover. Ravi Patel: SR behavior: when the popover opens announce via live region: "Sampling controls opened. Currently Adaptive at 10% sample rate." And announce slider updates live when changed. Lena Ortiz: Microcopy final: badge label "Sampling: Adaptive" with capitalized mode; popover title "Sampling settings"; help link text "What is sampling?" linking to docs. Jorge Morales: Engineering ask: hide estimated cost by default and add a small opt-in toggle "Show est. cost" inside the popover to avoid clutter and reduce billing confusion. Clara Nguyen: Agreement: keep badge visible with mode label, ensure keyboard & SR accessibility, hide cost behind opt-in, show throughput numeric on hover, collapse throughput on narrow screens. I'll iterate the figma and post link when ready. :raised_hands: Samira Lee: I'll review wording once figma is up and flag any billing/regulatory phrasing issues. :+1: DesignBot: auto-archiver: thread tagged design-review; remember to attach final figma link when pushing the PR.
